name: unreal-llm-index
description: Unreal Engine-aware index of your UE C++ project, its engine and Marketplace (Fab) plugins for any LLM in VS Code chat: find code and its callers, keep project memory across sessions, and evaluate how well your model answers.
author: Siddartha Gonnabattula

unrealLlmIndex.registerMcpServer.description: Register the index as an MCP server with VS Code, so chat agents can use its lookup tools automatically with whichever model is selected.

unrealLlmIndex.writeIndexFiles.description: Keep the .llm-index/ folder in the project up to date, so any agent that can read files can use the index.

unrealLlmIndex.engine.enabled.description: Index the engine the project uses, with its engine and Marketplace (Fab) plugins, so agents can look up engine classes such as ACharacter.

enumDescriptions: Build the engine index when a project is opened, and update it when the engine or its plugins change (checked at most every 12 hours).
Only when you run "Unreal LLM Index: Sync Engine Index".
unrealLlmIndex.engine.autoSync.description: When to build and update the engine index.

unrealLlmIndex.enginePath.markdownDescription: The engine to index: the folder that contains `Engine/`, e.g. `C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8`. Leave empty to use the project's `EngineAssociation`. **Unreal LLM Index: Select Engine…** lists the installs it can find.

unrealLlmIndex.cacheDir.markdownDescription: Where engine indexes are kept, about 300 MB per engine. Leave empty for the default: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\unreal-llm-index` on Windows, `~/Library/Caches/unreal-llm-index` on macOS, `~/.cache/unreal-llm-index` on Linux.

unrealLlmIndex.memory.enabled.markdownDescription: Keep project memory in `.llm-memory/` next to the `.uproject`: notes (decisions, facts, gotchas, open tasks) that agents save and read across sessions. Commit the folder to share it with your team.

unrealLlmIndex.maxResultTokens.markdownDescription: Largest tool result, in tokens (about 3.5 characters each). Raise it for long-context models, lower it for small ones. `0` sizes results for `@unreal` to the model (6% of its input limit).

unrealLlmIndex.maxReadLines.description: Most lines one read_lines or read_symbol call returns.

unrealLlmIndex.chat.maxToolRounds.description: Most rounds of tool calls @unreal makes for one question.

chatParticipants.name: unreal
chatParticipants.description: Ask about this Unreal project, its engine and plugins

commands.name: save
commands.description: Save this conversation's decisions, facts, gotchas and open tasks to project memory

commands.name: memory
commands.description: Show project memory: open tasks, decisions, facts and gotchas

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces the index is not written into the project, and the engine path and cache folder settings are ignored.
